arguments.title: Release checklist for the pocket terminal
arguments.body:
step 1: check the power rail
step 2: check the panel ribbon
step 3: check the keyboard matrix
step 4: check the speaker
step 5: check the microphone
step 6: check the wifi antenna
step 7: check the battery
step 8: check the sd card
step 9: check the usb port
step 10: check the boot log
step 11: check the systemd units
step 12: check the dst binary
step 13: check the fbterm font
step 14: check the touchpad
step 15: check the reset switch
